summary: Completed E2E testing of light/dark theme toggle feature for Reassura app. All 10 features tested and verified working correctly. Theme toggle button (sun/moon emoji in 34px circle) visible on all 5 screens. Toggle switches between light mode (cream #FDFAF7 background, dark text) and dark mode (dark #0A0806 background, light text) correctly.

issues: shadow* style props deprecated - Use boxShadow (cosmetic)
Animated: useNativeDriver not supported on web - JS fallback used

critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext implementation is clean with proper LIGHT and DARK token objects
ThemeToggle component uses correct testID='theme-toggle-button' for testing
Theme persistence via AsyncStorage working correctly
All screens properly use useTheme() hook for dynamic theming
I'm Home button correctly stays green gradient (exception honored)
Tab bar correctly adapts background to theme via theme.navBg
test_credentials: No credentials needed - bypass onboarding via localStorage.setItem('reassura_onboarding_v2', 'true')
context_for_next_testing_agent: Theme toggle feature fully implemented. ThemeToggle component uses data-testid='theme-toggle-button'. Toggle icon: moon (🌙) in light mode to switch to dark, sun (☀️) in dark mode to switch to light. Theme state persisted via AsyncStorage key 'reassura_theme'. I'm Home button uses LinearGradient that never changes with theme (exception). Tab bar uses BlurView with theme.navBg for background adaptation.
